name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
